amendment.reason: The first local output included the still-open terminal month of August 2026 despite the frozen requirement to report only complete calendar-month windows. The correction removes that terminal month before recomputation; no strategy, cost, horizon, contribution, or benchmark choice changed.
amendment.selection_effect: None. This analysis remains a retrospective transformation of the already-frozen Generation 4 allocation and is not used to promote a strategy.

claim_boundary: This is a retrospective cash-flow transformation of a consumed historical ETF allocation path. It is not a new holdout, an options backtest, a forecast, or evidence that a future three-month account will profit.

analysis.contribution_timing: Gross deposit at the start of the first modeled return interval in each calendar month.
analysis.cost_model: Fresh-account entry uses the engine's full L1 turnover convention; later deposits pay one-way cost on non-BIL purchases; paths end mark-to-market without liquidation.
analysis.implementation_boundary: Fractional ETF units; percentage-return paths remain the frozen causal ledgers; overlapping windows are descriptive and not independent probability estimates.
analysis.terminal_month_policy: The final observed month is excluded when a later Monday-through-Friday calendar date remains; this conservatively prevents a partial terminal month from being labeled complete.
analysis.detail_boundary: Window-level account summaries are retained. Daily balance paths can be regenerated only from the content-addressed local gzip ledger, which is intentionally not redistributed; public verification therefore checks the frozen outputs and hashes rather than reconstructing the private source ledger.
